text:
frank: Quick FYI, starting a narrow KMS owner-evidence sweep for billing/export keys tomorrow. Scope: owner labels, last-used evidence, external members, and prepare a canary unbind plan. ETA 48h. 

lia: I can do owner attribution + label reconciliations. Will not change labels without owner ack; will create tickets for missing owners.

nate: I'll run last-used heuristics and correlate with Airflow / cron schedules. Need to avoid monthly/export jobs.

frank: Ops, propose a short canary window Sat 04:30-05:15 UTC. Low traffic. Can we reserve that?

ops-bot: Canary window reserved: Sat 2024-11-02T04:30:00Z - 2024-11-02T05:15:00Z. Notifying infra oncall.

lia: Commands (read-only first):```bash
# list keys in keyring
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=billing-keyring --format="table(name,labels)"
# get IAM policy for key
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy billing-export-key --location=global --keyring=billing-keyring --format=json
```
I'll export CSV: key,keyring,member,role,label_owner,owner_ticket.

nate: Last-used snippet:```bash
# last auth for svcacct
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svcacct-*billing@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"
```
Heuristics: last_seen, log_count_90d, monthly_flag.

frank: Exception template in runbook should be minimal: owner, justification, expiry (max 14d without SRE approval), rollback steps, evidence link. Lia/nate please follow that.

audit-bot: scan queued: /scans/least_priv/3301112222. ETA: 2024-11-02T04:35:00Z. Output to /shared/audit/least-priv/3301112222/report.json

lia: Uploaded initial inventory: https://files.redwood/internal/least-priv/3301112222/kms-inventory.csv. Found 5 keys with missing owner labels and 3 keys with external members.

nate: Uploaded last-used CSV: https://files.redwood/internal/least-priv/3301112222/last-used.csv. Marked 2 svcaccts as monthly_flag (billing-export schedules).

frank: Critical: DO NOT unbind keys with external members or project-wide editor/owner roles without explicit owner or partner confirmation. Mark as HIGH-RISK.

ops-bot: Owners notified for flagged bindings. 48h TTL for confirmation.

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: 34 keys scanned; 8 bindings flagged; 3 external members; 5 ownerless keys; 2 monthly-job svcaccts. Full report: /shared/audit/least-priv/3301112222/report.json

lia: I'll open tickets for ownerless keys (TICKET-PL-219) and add ownerless label. Will not prune until owners respond or TTL expires.

nate: For the canary unbind plan: stage in canary project, unbind target member, wait 30m, monitor 500s/alerts + ingestion lag, revert if >0.5% error delta. Rollback commands in runbook.

frank: Next steps: 1) lia/nate annotate candidates with evidence + suggested action 2) wait owner responses (48h) 3) infra prepare revert playbook 4) security triage exceptions. We'll reconvene after owner TTL. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
